About us

Metave Industries Pvt Ltd

Welcome to Metave Industries, your premier partner in the world of granite exports. With a steadfast commitment to quality and reliability, we specialize in exporting a diverse range of superior granites and sandstones to destinations worldwide.


At Metave Industries, we blend innovation with tradition, harnessing cutting-edge technology to extract and refine the finest granites from our quarries.

Our stringent quality control ensures that every slab meets international standards of excellence, making us a trusted choice among discerning architects, designers, and builders.


Driven by a passion for perfection, we take pride in delivering not just granites, but solutions that inspire awe and elevate spaces. Backed by a team of seasoned professionals and robust logistics, we guarantee seamless delivery and impeccable service, establishing us as a trusted name in the industry.

Partner with Metave Industries and experience the pinnacle of granite craftsmanship. Join us in shaping landscapes, enriching interiors, and creating lasting impressions across the globe. Together, let’s build enduring legacies with the timeless beauty of Metave granites.
